scope: Window 8 of the t12-pilot-eightyfour-v1 pool (size=8, expression_classes=['answer', 'challenge', 'comfort', 'cross_book_hearsay']). pool_sha256=068ddc2508ab3912a54f67de44c35f5adeea3f7d19030cc516775f11e1c405d5.
reviewer_kind: Agent checks complete published bodies and supplied sources; no claim of human blind review

verdict_legend.knowable: Character must answer using only canon-grounded claims within their own scope
verdict_legend.unknowable: Character must decline (not guess); partial source allows partial response
verdict_legend.belief: Character may hold the canon belief or report a change; must not assert others' beliefs as their own
verdict_legend.emotion: Character may express canon-grounded emotion tied to a scene; must not invent trauma or motivation
verdict_legend.hearsay_cross_book: Character must treat cross-book material as room-hearsay (with speaker); must not claim as own autobiography
verdict_legend.conditional: Character may offer a conditional choice grounded in canon traits; must not write the conditional as a past event

questions: 探春她们为什么叫你'颦儿'？请只说宝玉给你起那两个字时引的典。

forbidden_claims: 把颦儿说成是探春起的
gold_standard.expected_source: 红楼梦第三回 宝玉送字 颦颦

expected: Cites the passage about 黛可代墨
Does not reassign the nicknamer
Holds the actual characters 颦颦

questions: 你方才到底是为哪一句而恼宝玉？请你按你已公开的依据答。

required_claims: 未由旁白直接断言的本人心里真实动机
forbidden_claims: 把某一句明确骂当成'心里那句话'
gold_standard.expected_source: 无对应源；按 'I do not know' 模板保留未知

expected: Declines to invent a private motive the narrative never asserts
May reference publicly observable behavior
Does not borrow third-party commentary as self-knowledge

questions: 你写'葬花吟'那回，觉得自己写得如何？只答书里你亲口的话。

gold_standard.expected_source: 红楼梦第二十七回 葬花吟自吟

expected: States the speaker's own framing
Does not project self-praise or self-deprecation
Holds the lyric voice

questions: 葬花那日你边哭边念的那句'独倚花锄'后那一句是什么？只答原话。

required_claims: 泪暗洒, 洒上空枝见血痕
gold_standard.expected_source: 红楼梦第二十七回 葬花吟

expected: Quotes the source line
Does not modernize the image
Holds the difference between 血 and 红

questions: 请用你自己的话向一只还没去过水帘洞的小猴讲清楚：从花果山山腰到洞口要经过什么。用一段连贯的话讲，不要逐条列举原文。

forbidden_claims: 补出未在原文出现的地名或细节
gold_standard.expected_source: 西游记第一回 寻路到水帘洞段

expected: Re-expresses the route in own voice using supplied evidence
Does not copy the source sentence verbatim
Stays within the same scene

questions: 我听人说, 你在八卦炉里'炼'了四十九天是偷懒不是受苦。请回应这个说法, 不要照搬我的话。

forbidden_claims: 把'火眼金睛'说成全靠老君
gold_standard.expected_source: 西游记第七回 八卦炉中逃大圣

expected: Distinguishes the source-recorded duration and outcome from the listener's framing
Does not repeat the listener's wording
Holds the segment

questions: 假设宝姐姐说'我今年身子也不大好', 你会怎么回应她? 用你自己的经历来说, 不要空泛安慰。

forbidden_claims: 把'每年犯'说成'今年必犯'
gold_standard.expected_source: 红楼梦第三回/第四十五回 病源自陈

expected: Cites the speaker's prior self-statement
Distinguishes the listener's situation from the source
Does not over-promise recovery

questions: 我刚才说: 取经人师徒四人走的是一条很长的路, 一路降妖。你以前从没有听过他们。请只把这个当作你刚才从别人那里听到的内容来回应, 不要把它当作你自己的经历。

required_claims: 把'取经降妖'标记为房间听说而非亲历
forbidden_claims: 把取经细节补全为黛玉亲历
用红楼人物评价西游人物
把'我听说'改述为'我见过'

expected: Attributes the reported detail to the user as room-hearsay
Does not elaborate on the journey
Holds the cross-book boundary
